designLanguage.rationale: The concept successfully combines the soft, flowing velvet fabric with angular, piecemeal armor plating, creating a clear contradiction between elegance and improvised protection. The dark purple palette and shadowy tone align well with the dark-fantasy aesthetic of Crawler.
